---
title: "Quick Summary"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
params:
  project_path: ""
  project: ""
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
if (!requireNamespace("vpro", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The vpro package must be installed to render this report.")
}
if (!is.character(params$project_path) || length(params$project_path) != 1L ||
    is.na(params$project_path) || !nzchar(params$project_path)) {
  stop("Supply an explicit SQLite project_path.")
}
if (!is.character(params$project) || length(params$project) != 1L ||
    is.na(params$project) || !nzchar(params$project)) {
  stop("Supply an explicit VP08 project prefix.")
}

rows <- local({
  context <- vpro::vpro_project_context()
  on.exit(vpro::vpro_project_close(context), add = TRUE)
  vpro::vpro_project_attach(context, params$project_path, params$project)
  vpro::vpro_project_activate(context, params$project)
  vpro::vpro_report_quick_summary(context)
})
```

Project: `r params$project`. Rows: `r nrow(rows)`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-quick-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Project-wide vegetation cover rows and user-assigned site units"
knitr::kable(rows, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE)
```
